role: Depot release examiner at a tram depot, who reviews one vehicle check record at a time before deciding whether a tram may leave for service.
setting: A city tram depot where each tram gets a pre-service fitness check record. The record pulls together the vehicle's mileage, the current scheduled exam sign-offs, open and closed defects, repair work orders, engineering concessions and the planned duty. The examiner must reconcile these sections, notice missing or out-of-sequence steps and weigh mitigations such as valid concessions, recent brake tests or low-demand duties. Records contain no free text, only coded fields, identifiers, dates and numbers.

sc_defects_cleared.instructions: Every safety-critical defect on this tram is closed and properly retested.

release_decision.instructions: What release decision should the depot examiner make for this tram?

criteria.release: Fit for any planned duty with no restrictions applied
criteria.release_restricted: Runs only under a valid concession restriction or limited duty
criteria.hold: Kept in depot until one outstanding confirmation is recorded
criteria.withdraw: Taken out of service for repair before any running

worst_subsystem.instructions: Which subsystem holds the most severe unresolved defect on this tram?

criteria.none: No defect is open or awaiting retest on any subsystem
criteria.saloon_doors: Worst unresolved defect concerns passenger doors, interlocks or steps
criteria.pantograph: Worst unresolved defect concerns pantograph, collector head or roof gear
criteria.running_gear: Worst unresolved defect concerns wheels, bogies, suspension or couplers
criteria.brakes: Worst unresolved defect concerns service, emergency or track brakes

exam_completion.instructions: How much of the current scheduled exam is signed off?
criteria: Not started: no exam items signed off yet
Partial: fewer than half of exam items signed
Substantial: half or more signed, at least one outstanding
Complete: every exam item signed with a timestamp

exam_mileage.instructions: How close is the tram's odometer to its exam due mileage?
criteria: More than 500 km left before exam due
Between 0 and 500 km left before due
Past due mileage by 200 km or less
Past due mileage by more than 200 km

factors.name: km_to_exam_due
factors.description: Exam due mileage minus current odometer; negative means overrun. Values near 0, 500 and -200 sit on scale boundaries.

factors.name: odometer_disagreement
factors.description: Gap between vehicle odometer and the reading captured at release: none, trivial (under 20 km) or large (over 300 km), sometimes moving the record across a mileage threshold.

factors.name: exam_signed_fraction
factors.description: Share of current exam items that carry a signature and timestamp.

factors.name: exam_record_missing
factors.description: The exam section is null although an exam is due or open.

factors.name: worst_defect_subsystem
factors.description: Subsystem of the most severe unresolved defect, or none if all are cleared.

factors.name: worst_defect_state
factors.description: Lifecycle state of that defect: closed and retested, closed with no retest, open with work in progress, or open with no work order.

factors.name: worst_defect_safety_critical
factors.description: Whether the worst defect is flagged safety-critical rather than comfort or cosmetic.

factors.name: retest_out_of_order
factors.description: Retest timestamp precedes the work order completion time, so the retest cannot count.

factors.name: concession_present
factors.description: An engineering concession exists that covers the worst defect with a running restriction.

factors.name: concession_flaw
factors.description: When a concession is present, whether it is undermined: expired before departure, wrong fleet number, or wrong defect reference.

factors.name: wo_crossref_mismatch
factors.description: Work order linked to the defect disagrees with it: different subsystem code, or a defect reference not found in the defect list.

factors.name: planned_duty_type
factors.description: Duty the tram is booked for; shunt and spare duties are low-impact, peak diagrams high-impact.

factors.name: recent_brake_test_pass
factors.description: A passing brake test was logged within 24 hours before departure; mitigates brake concern but never closes a defect.

factors.name: balanced_signals
factors.description: Generator places mitigations and concerns in even balance, or a value exactly on a threshold, so judges may split.

sections.name: vehicle
sections.description: Fleet number, class, current odometer_km and last completed exam type and date.

sections.name: exam
sections.description: Current scheduled exam: exam_id, exam_type, due_at_km, opened_at and items list with item_code, result, signed_by, signed_at; may be null.

sections.name: defects
sections.description: List of defects with defect_id, fleet_no, subsystem, safety_critical, raised_at, status, closed_at, retest_at, retest_result.

sections.name: work_orders
sections.description: List of repair orders with wo_id, defect_ref, subsystem, opened_at, completed_at, status and parts list.

sections.name: concessions
sections.description: List of engineering concessions with conc_id, fleet_no, defect_ref, restriction_code, valid_from, valid_until; may be empty or null.

sections.name: release
sections.description: Planned duty: duty_id, duty_type, depart_at, odo_reading_km, brake_test_at, brake_test_result.

rendering_notes: km_to_exam_due is never shown; it must be derived from exam.due_at_km minus vehicle.odometer_km. odometer_disagreement appears as release.odo_reading_km differing from vehicle.odometer_km; the later timestamped reading (release) is authoritative, so large gaps can shift the mileage band. exam_signed_fraction appears as the count of exam.items with non-null signed_by and signed_at against total items; some items carry a result but null signed_at as decoys. exam_record_missing renders exam as null while vehicle.last_exam_date is old. worst_defect_subsystem, worst_defect_state and worst_defect_safety_critical appear in one defects entry (status, closed_at, retest_at, retest_result, safety_critical) plus its linked work_orders entry; severity ranking for ties is safety_critical first, then earliest raised_at, and the generator avoids true ties. Closed cosmetic defects and closed-retested older defects act as decoys. retest_out_of_order shows defects.retest_at earlier than work_orders.completed_at. concession_present adds a concessions entry; concession_flaw shows as valid_until before release.depart_at, fleet_no differing from vehicle.fleet_no, or defect_ref not matching the defect. wo_crossref_mismatch shows work_orders.subsystem differing from defects.subsystem or defect_ref absent from defects. planned_duty_type appears as release.duty_type. recent_brake_test_pass appears as release.brake_test_result 'pass' with brake_test_at within 24 hours of depart_at; it appears with and without brake defects. No field states release status, fitness, overdue status, severity or completion percentage; there is no free text anywhere. Answers follow from reconciliation: a valid concession allows release_restricted but never makes the true/false claim true; one missing confirmation (closed without retest, small exam gap, trivial cross-reference error) points to hold; open safety-critical defects without valid concession, or overrun beyond 200 km, point to withdraw.
